headline: 4 IPOs close today; Tonbo (GMP 74%) and Bonfiglioli lead, but GMPs fell for Zetwerk, SMT and Bonfiglioli — skip Zetwerk

tonbo-imaging.category_note: Closes today. GMP rising since 12 Oct (₹515). Retail 21.5x, odds ≥1 in 22; 1 lot per family PAN

zetwerk.category_note: GMP falling since 17 Oct (₹3, peak ₹23), loss-making, Retail only 0.49x — skip

sahajanand-medical-technologies.category_note: GMP falling since 15 Oct (₹47 → ₹21) — apply 1 lot only if you'd hold; Retail 1.64x, odds ≥1 in 2

bonfiglioli-transmissions.category_note: GMP falling since 17 Oct (peak ₹181, now ₹108) but still 18%; Retail 4.1x, odds ≥1 in 4

paras-healthcare.category_note: GMP falling since 15 Oct (₹111 → ₹75); opens 21 Oct, anchor pending

notes: BLS Polymers analysed from RHP; the financial tables did not extract, so FY26 PAT is derived from the litigation threshold.
